name: Dreamy Indie Girlhood
summary: This page describes the photographic aesthetic popular on Tumblr in the early 2010s.
description: This page describes the photographic aesthetic popular on Tumblr in the early 2010s. The aesthetic, which is unnamed, depicts the world of teenaged girls, but one that utilizes vintage, ethereal visuals which emphasizes femininity but in a manner that aims to be real and intimate, rather than polished. This perspective originates from Rookie magazine and the photographer Petra Collins, but its look derives from older films and music subcultures and is influenced by the renewed interest in emotional authenticity and artistic look associated with 2010 Hipster and Twee perspectives.
